test_coverage_notes: Validation logic is indirectly tested via tests that deserialize or construct ledger entries. Likely test files: STObject_test.cpp, LedgerFormats_test.cpp, and various transaction/ledger entry tests in the rippled/test/ directory. Direct unit tests for LedgerFormats or SOTemplate are rare; most coverage is via integration tests that exercise ledger entry parsing and validation. Gaps: No explicit unit tests for getCommonFields or the macro expansion logic; edge cases in field validation (e.g., missing required fields, wrong types) may not be exhaustively tested.
